symptoms.name: Pump runs, but no water delivered

causes.name: Flow through pump completely or partially obstructed.
causes.fix: Locate and remove obstruction. Refer to repair instructions for disassembly.

causes.name: Pump lost prime.
causes.fix: Reprime. Inspect suction system for air leaks.

causes.name: Pressure required by system at design flow rate exceeds
causes.fix: partially closed valve in discharge piping system.

causes.name: Obstruction in suction piping
causes.fix: Locate and remove obstruction.

causes.name: Low voltage at motor.
causes.fix: Running voltage across each leg of motor must be ±10% of nominal voltage shown on nameplate.

causes.name: Motor leads improperly grouped for voltage.
causes.fix: Refer to lead grouping diagram on motor nameplate.

causes.name: Frequency variation.
causes.fix: Check frequency of power system. Must be less than 5% variation from motor nameplate rating.
